_what: a11ign's HOST declaration: the machine's facts, which no project's repository can know (ADR 0040, decision 3; #2620, child 3f of #69). `src/host-config.mjs` of a11ign/agent-org is the one reader. Keys starting with an underscore are prose and are not read.
_where: The path is `$AGENT_ORG_HOST`, and until a unit sets it (the shadow-run and extraction rows, 4 and 5) it is this file, beside the project's own declaration. NO UNIT IS RENAMED OR REINSTALLED BY THE ROW THAT ADDED THIS FILE: every value below is the one the units, the routing wrapper and the readers already named.
_tool: Where the TOOL runs from (ADR 0040, decision 3; cut-over 3 of 6, #2974): the checkout of a11ign/agent-org, beside the projects it serves and never inside one. Set on 2026-10-02 by the cut, NO rollback copy. The work-tick unit then runs `update-tool` first, which since a11ign/a11ign#3443 detaches the checkout at the NEWEST RELEASE TAG of agent-org (not at its main), so a merge is live when `release.yml` tags it, about nine minutes later, and a merge with no changeset is never live. `toolVersion` (`latest`, or a tag such as `vX.Y.Z`) is the rollback: name the previous tag, and pin one cut after #3443.
_clones: Where the clone of each KEYED code repository `project.json` declares lives (#2969), by key. A keyed reviewer's checkout is made by fetching `refs/pull/<n>/head` from THAT clone's `origin`; the tick's own checkout's `origin` is the primary's repository, whose pull request of the same number would be the wrong review. A key with no clone here is refused by name. This is NOT a `projects` entry: a project is one with its own declaration, and a keyed code repository has none.

leadsHeader: The gh wrapper (packages/agent-org/host/gh) reads this: a workspace id on a line BY ITSELF below acts as
a11ign-ai-leads (write, not admin; its own GraphQL pool). Every other agent workspace gets
a11ign-ai-workers, and NO agent workspace acts as the human account. Comment lines never match an id.
Installed by `agent-org host:install` to ~/leads/workspaces.txt; `agent-org host:check` reports DIVERGED
when the installed copy differs. Chairman's identity ruling, 2026-09-24 (#1950, #2332, #2333).
